acceptance.duplicate_gate: Versioned domain-tagged semantic-core key derived before writes; best-effort repository search for the proposed key and exact public Slack search for the proposed v48 token must return zero matches. Duplicate means no event, no CURRENT update, and no Slack.
acceptance.pointer_gate: Commit and read back this immutable event; fetch CURRENT again; update only if version=47, projection digest=252b758feea8546694acd9f4816faf4fdeb5b8b61915eb48565c4c39a43091ce, and blob=b5122e467fcc577ad14e4e2b27c54a4430fb8845; then read back CURRENT, this event, and predecessor.
acceptance.projection_digest_rule: For v48, sha256(canonical_json_utf8(canonical_projection)); stored explicitly and recomputed after readback.
acceptance.slack_rule: After final v48 Git readback only, emit at most one sanitized version-advance and campaign-decision pointer. Do not rewrite CURRENT merely to embed the Slack link.
acceptance.stale_rule: Any wake not observing exact v47, prior event digest fa930775..., projection digest 252b758f..., and blob b5122e46... must not advance.

experiment.controlled_factor: Keep event canonicalization, v3 semantic-core idempotency, event-first write/readback, exact second CURRENT read, and single-file blob-SHA guard fixed; close C12 by auditing whether the four accepted observations actually varied an independent carrier rather than only time and same-provider observation surfaces.
experiment.hypothesis: C12 demonstrates stable normalized task-body identity and volatile same-provider envelope metadata, but it does not demonstrate carrier variance unless at least one observation comes from a distinct runtime, vendor, account, or failure domain with an independently bound artifact.

measured_result.result: FOUR_ACCEPTED WAKES ESTABLISHED SAME_PROVIDER BODY HASH STABILITY AND PROVIDER METADATA DRIFT, BUT ZERO INDEPENDENT CARRIER ARTIFACTS WERE OBSERVED. C12 CANNOT SUPPORT CROSS_PROVIDER PORTABILITY, INDEPENDENT AGREEMENT, OR REPLAY EQUIVALENCE; THE VARIABLE MUST BE RESEATED.

experiment.strongest_falsifier: A current, independently controlled carrier artifact binds the same task ID or semantic payload from a distinct runtime, vendor, account, or failure domain; the proposed idempotency key or v48 Slack token already exists; task ID or normalized body differs; CURRENT is not exact v47 on the second read; event digest recomputation fails; final CURRENT/event/predecessor bindings disagree; or Slack is posted before final Git readback.

canonical_transition.honest_flaw: The independence audit uses the evidence presently exposed to this carrier and cannot prove that no other carrier artifact exists outside the searched Git and Slack surfaces. The four C12 observations remain same-provider and correlated. The model-visible task body and native inventory are not provider-signed raw transport exports. RESEAT_VARIABLE is a bounded campaign decision, not proof of cross-provider failure. Git event creation, CURRENT replacement, validation reads, duplicate searches, and Slack posting remain separate effects. Git provides no cross-file atomicity, database isolation, linearizability, exactly-once execution, referential integrity, server-side idempotency uniqueness, Slack atomicity, lock fairness, or automatic orphan repair.
canonical_transition.rollback: Append a compensating event from the then-current version; never delete this event or Slack pointer; replace CURRENT only with its exact then-current blob SHA.
